scientific_question: Does the H1.8 selective state-aware SUCCESS rescue reproduce on independent seeds, and is it selective relative to BASE and compact-v2?
hypothesis: The H1.8 SUCCESS/state-aware-v3 rescue on held-out partition A will reproduce on fresh seeds; if it appears only on goal 3396, the effect is task-specific rather than broad held-out transfer.

controls.task_panel: frozen H1.8 held-out partition A; no training or task changes

frozen_variables.runtime: pinned JDK/HF cache and one UUID-bound process per cell
frozen_variables.adapters: BASE none; SUCCESS frozen H1 success adapter; no retraining

cell_design: 4 prompt/model conditions x 2 independent seed blocks = 8 cells; 4 tasks x 4 seeds/cell; 128 total attempts
gpu_plan: one independent UUID-bound cell per authorized GPU; no DDP or duplicate deterministic cell
primary_metrics: SUCCESS state-aware minus SUCCESS compact paired reward

stop_branch.replicated_selective: SUCCESS state-aware has >=2 qualified positives in each block and exceeds compact with BASE at zero: proceed to a new-task confirmation before any D0 design
stop_branch.seed_or_task_specific: positive effect appears in only one block or one task: retain H1.8 as task-specific evidence and do not open D0
stop_branch.null: no qualified positives: classify H1.8 rescue as non-reproducible; stop prompt tweaking
stop_branch.runtime_failure: exclude invalid cells and open a separate repair group

claim_boundary: Fresh-seed confirmation on a frozen held-out partition; the replicated rescue is task-specific to goal 3396, not a benchmark/generalization claim; no D0 opening and no SEED comparison.

result.block_result: S1 and S2 SUCCESS/state-aware-v3 each 4/16 positive; every compact and BASE control 0/16
result.positive_task: goal 3396 only; all eight fresh seeds
result.resource_note: No compute PID remains; GPU1 retains 19850 MiB through a pre-existing nvitop handle. Do not allocate GPU1 until released; no reset or kill performed.
result.next: Pre-register H1.10 new-task state-aware transfer; keep D0 closed
